summary: RemSleep Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a change in control via private stock purchases. Roman Israel Wood sold ~80% of preferred shares (3.6M Preferred C, 400K Preferred B, 4M Preferred A) to 1000152403 ONTARIO INC for cash and assumption of ~$300K debt. Additionally, Wood sold 40M restricted common shares to Miro Zecevic and Anita L. Michaels assigned her preferred shares to the Ontario entity, giving it ~100% preferred control. All transactions were off-market, all-cash. Former CEO, COO, and President resigned; new officers were appointed. Watch for regulatory filings or further operational changes from the new controlling shareholder.
